conversion.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS; Khronos glTF Blender I/O v5.2.40
conversion.source_method: batched the 36 supplied Collection 1 LOD0 mesh parts into one glTF primitive; baked source object transforms; preserved supplied positions, polygons, UVs, and inverse-transpose loop normals

material_mapping.roughness_note: reviewed scalar legacy-material adaptation; not authored roughness texture data
material_mapping.specular_note: glTF core metallic-roughness does not encode source specular_intensity 0.0. KHR_materials_specular was tested but Godot 4.7 ignores it, so omitted. Godot's imported StandardMaterial3D metallic_specular remains default 0.5; no runtime workaround is applied.

import.geometry_policy: original source archives are preserved; Quaternius runtime tree buffers clamp only finite float COLOR_0 values in (1, 1.0002] to 1; oak LOD0 joins the 36 source parts while preserving positions and UVs exactly and normals within the conversion proof
import.lod_policy: Godot 4.7.2 ResourceImporterScene automatic mesh LODs enabled for glTF assets; the oak source contributes LOD0 only, with supplier LOD1/LOD2 excluded; Wavefront OBJ assets use supplied geometry
import.shared_material_policy: original Quaternius glTF materials and textures are preserved; the oak legacy M_Quercus material maps its packed atlas to Principled BSDF base color with roughness 1.0 and BLEND alpha, as recorded in the conversion proof; Godot 4.7.2 imports metallic_specular at its native 0.5 default; OBJ/MTL diffuse materials are preserved; shared source files are extracted once

buffer_derivation.method: Clamp finite float COLOR_0 components above 1 and at or below 1.0002 to 1; reject negative, non-finite, over-limit, or unsupported color accessors.
